free_parameters.name: units_per_one
free_parameters.why: Denominator 2**53 equals random.random()'s exact grid, so integer units map exactly to the RNG draw.

free_parameters.name: op_name
free_parameters.why: A single unary op keeps the generated graph tiny and inserts reliably on both branches.

free_parameters.name: init_rank
free_parameters.why: Repository default rank for the initial placeholder; the target decision does not read rank.

free_parameters.name: max_nodes
free_parameters.why: Stops the generation loop after one insertion, leaving exactly one target decision.

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: Fixed seed makes the uniform draw at the target line deterministic across processes.

free_parameters.name: timeout_ms
free_parameters.why: Large enough that insertion succeeds immediately; the target is reached before any timeout.

free_parameters.name: init_fp
free_parameters.why: Forces a float32 placeholder so the chosen ReLU op is type-compatible and inserts first try.
